pattern: ^SELECT .+ FROM (?P<inner_query>SELECT .+ GROUP BY .* HAVING COUNT(\*).+) AS t[0-9]+ JOIN Transcripts .*$
correction: Join the Transcript_Contents and Transcripts tables directly and count the number of rows in the Transcript_Contents table for each transcript id to meet the requirement of at least 2 entries.

metadata.description: This rule identifies SQL queries that incorrectly use a subquery with an aggregate function and a HAVING clause to filter records, instead of directly counting the number of rows in the main table.
